categories.main_business_segments: Dalian Dalicap Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic components industry, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of radio frequency (RF) microwave ceramic capacitors. Its main products include RF microwave multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC) and single-layer ceramic capacitors (SLCC), which are widely used in civil industrial and military applications such as mobile communication base stations, medical imaging equipment, military devices, rail transit signal equipment, semiconductor RF power supplies, and laser equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes including dry film casting, layering, printing, and high-temperature sintering to produce high-quality MLCCs with high Q values, low equivalent series resistance (ESR), high self-resonant frequency, and high reliability. It uses precious metals like palladium and silver for internal electrodes and has mastered the full production process from raw material formulation to testing. The company also focuses on R&D in materials, product design, and RF application testing to maintain technological competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic mobile communication base station equipment manufacturers, global high-end medical imaging equipment producers such as GE Healthcare and Siemens Healthineers, Chinese railway signaling companies, and well-known semiconductor and power technology firms like Advanced Energy Industries and MKS Instruments. The company serves both civilian industrial markets and military sectors, holding certifications and qualifications for military-grade products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for about 66% of revenue, and also exports to developed countries including the United States, Japan, and Europe. It has established overseas subsidiaries in Singapore, Japan, and Hong Kong to support international trade and plans to expand its global sales network further in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dalian Dalicap Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronic components supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of ceramic capacitors. It procures raw materials such as electrode slurry and ceramic powders from upstream suppliers and sells finished components directly to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven growth with a strategic focus on R&D to enhance product performance and diversify its product portfolio. Key R&D projects include developing low dielectric constant, low-temperature sintering ceramic powders, low-cost silver-palladium alloy electrodes, miniaturized high-Q capacitors, and military-grade high-Q capacitors. It also invests in intelligent manufacturing and digital management to improve production efficiency and supply chain responsiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic components, especially RF microwave MLCCs and SLCCs, to industrial and military customers. The company uses a combination of direct sales and limited agency sales channels, with pricing negotiated based on customer scale, order volume, delivery schedules, and market conditions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major international players such as ATC (USA), Knowles, and Murata (Japan), which dominate over half of the global and Chinese RF microwave MLCC market. Dalian Dalicap is among the leading domestic suppliers with a growing technological capability and market share, aiming to achieve product performance parity and expand its presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 323 million, a 6.47% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 114 million, down 8.86%. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.43 billion and equity of RMB 1.35 billion, showing moderate scale with some recent revenue contraction due to industry slowdown. R&D investment increased to 6.88% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented strategy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dalian Dalicap offers high-performance, high-reliability RF microwave ceramic capacitors with superior electrical characteristics such as high Q value, low ESR, and high self-resonant frequency, enabling stable circuits and efficient signal transmission. Its full-process domestic manufacturing capability supports cost competitiveness and supply security, facilitating localization and substitution of imported components. The company also emphasizes strong quality management, military-grade certifications, and close technical collaboration with customers to deliver tailored solutions.
